headline: McKesson’s (NYSE:MCK) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates
summary: Healthcare distributor and services company McKesson (NYSE:MCK) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.7% year on year to $105.4 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $9.93 per share was 4.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
